app_fee.value: Loyola charges no application fee for graduate programs, including for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: Loyola does not charge an application fee

fee_waiver.value: There is no application fee, so there is nothing to waive.
fee_waiver.quote: Loyola does not charge an application fee

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each program sets its own test requirements.
gre_general.quote: As program requirements vary, please visit your program's page using the Program Finder for the latest requirements on test scores

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School minimum is TOEFL iBT 4 on the new 6-point scale, which is 79 on the old 120-point scale.

also.quote: The Graduate School language requirements apply to all The Graduate School programs, including master's and doctoral programs administered by The Graduate School

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School minimum is IELTS Academic 6.0 overall.

english_waiver.value: India is not on Loyola's waiver country list, so Indian applicants need a test score even if their degree was taught in English.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who are currently completing or who have completed a bachelor's degree or master's degree in the U.S. or at a recognized institution in the above countries at which the language of instruction is English

also.quote: This requirement is waived for applicants from the following countries

notes: Graduate School rules, which apply to IPBS, Chemistry and Computer Science PhDs. Test scores must go directly from the testing service to gradapp@luc.edu (institution code 1412) and are valid for two years. Transcript evaluation from a NACES member is required for non-US credentials.
